this_title: National Theatre at Home: War Horse
introduction: At the outbreak of the First World War, young Albert’s beloved horse Joey is sold to the cavalry and shipped to France. Too young to enlist, Albert refuses to forget him, embarking on an extraordinary journey from the fields of rural Devon to the trenches of wartime France – determined to bring Joey home.Based on Michael Morpurgo’s beloved novel, the play War Horse is a timeless story of love, courage and friendship, brought to life by astonishing life-sized puppet horses from Handspring Puppet Company and a stirring musical score.Following a sell-out national tour, the Tony® Award–winning global sensation is captured where it all began, nearly two decades after its debut at the National Theatre.
